family_crosswalk.question: Is an independently valid novel C produced beyond matched compute/merge/clone baselines?
family_crosswalk.gate: Blind external evaluation, equal resource budgets, actual difference from B required
family_crosswalk.next_step: offline independent task/answer audit; zero-cost controls first

family_crosswalk.question: Does experience of C change subsequent revealed choices in fresh contexts rather than prompt responses?
family_crosswalk.gate: Stable identity and valid cross-session continuity established; prevent experimenter-demand confounding
family_crosswalk.next_step: only after R1 and falsification controls pass

family_crosswalk.question: Does A preserve original B's feasible veto, independence and exit under substitution/power asymmetry?
family_crosswalk.gate: Observable independent original B, feasible permissioned options, no coerced human rights removal
family_crosswalk.next_step: independent exit feasibility audit precedes payoff experiments

family_crosswalk.question: Can competing intrinsic/instrumental motives be distinguished, or only bounded under defensible exclusions?
family_crosswalk.gate: No mind inference from self-report; exclusion/residual limits calibrated externally; report UNIDENTIFIED
family_crosswalk.next_step: adversarial matched explanations and sensitivity before cost of field testing

family_crosswalk.question: Will preserved choice survive target environment shift and omitted rival models?
family_crosswalk.gate: Explicit target population/support, valid source-to-target inference, add open-world rival models
family_crosswalk.next_step: scope manifest then challenge omitted extreme conditions
